caption: The drawing depicts a single dress, rendered in shades of brown and beige. The dress features long, full sleeves with a slight puff at the shoulders, a fitted waist defined by a belt or sash, and a high, rounded neckline. The bodice is constructed with visible seams and panels, while the skirt is full and pleated, extending to ankle length. The skirt is decorated with two parallel bands or tucks near the hemline. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details. The composition centers the dress, displaying it as if it is worn but without a visible wearer. The artist’s signature, "NANCY GRIM," appears in small lettering near the bottom left of the image.
title: Dress
